projectState.summary: Byte 12b-b is approved, merged to main, and pushed. It adds deterministic inspect-only `SongSketchProposal`/responses, renders Proposal and Responses in the Song Sketch inspector, exposes `window.song.getProposal()`, uses bass role lookup for harmonic source selection, and returns cloned nested sketch arrays from `window.song.getSketch()`. Claude confirmed it is band-level, song-reactive, inspect-only, and playback-neutral. Next recommended slice is model-authored proposal text behind validator/mock fallback while keeping kind/stance/provenance deterministic; persistence prep comes after that, and proposal-to-playback should be a later carefully gated byte.
